title: InanXR/FLASH
abstract: FLASH: From-scratch NeRF using Instant-NGP hash encoding. Multi-resolution spatial hashing + occupancy grids = 5x faster rendering. ~3k lines PyTorch, full volume rendering pipeline, hierarchical sampling, FP16 optimization. Trains to 32 dB PSNR in 15 min on RTX 4050. Built by a 13-year-old from Bangladesh.
